source.text: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא יִהְיוּ֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם מְדַבְּרוֹת֙ שְׂפַ֣ת כְּנַ֔עַן וְ/נִשְׁבָּע֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עִ֣יר הַ/הֶ֔רֶס יֵאָמֵ֖ר לְ/אֶחָֽת׃ס

translation.text: In that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt speaking the language of Canaan and swearing allegiance to the LORD of Armies. One of them will be called the City of Destruction[a].

footnotes.text: 1QIsaᵃ and 4QIsaᵇ, two Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts, read “City of the Sun” instead of “City of Destruction.” The Hebrew text followed here reads “City of Destruction.”
